definitions.explanation: The branch of the Taira clan led by {平清盛|たいらのきよもり} that dominated the court in the late twelfth century and was destroyed by the Minamoto in the Genpei War, which ended at Dan-no-ura in 1185.

examples.japanese: {平家|へいけ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{壇|だん}ノ{浦|うら}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{滅|ほろ}んだ→滅ぶ：31716_horobu⟧。
examples.english: The Heike were destroyed at Dan-no-ura.

examples.japanese: 『⟦{平家物語|へいけものがたり}→平家物語：31060_heikemonogatari⟧』⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{琵琶法師|びわほうし}⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧{語|かた}り{伝|つた}えられた。
examples.english: The Tale of the Heike was passed down by blind lute-playing priests.

examples.japanese: ⟦{運動会|うんどうかい}→運動会：03013_undoukai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{紅白|こうはく}→紅白：13805_kouhaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{源氏|げんじ}→源氏：16644_genji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{白旗|しらはた}→白旗：19398_shirahata⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{平家|へいけ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{赤旗|あかはた}→赤旗：28002_akahata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{由来|ゆらい}→由来：05451_yurai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{説|せつ}→説：00360_setsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: One theory traces the red and white teams at school sports days to the white banners of the Genji and the red banners of the Heike.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{平家物語|へいけものがたり}→平家物語：31060_heikemonogatari⟧: The Tale of the Heike, the great war epic
- ⟦{源氏|げんじ}→源氏：16644_genji⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{平家|へいけ}: the Genji and the Heike, the two sides of the Genpei War
- {平家|へいけ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{落人|おちうど}: Heike fugitives who fled into remote mountain villages after the defeat

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {驕|おご}る{平家|へいけ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{久|ひさ}しからず: the proud Heike do not last long, i.e. pride goes before a fall

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{平氏|へいし}→平氏：25014_heishi⟧: the Taira clan as a whole; {平家|へいけ} usually means Kiyomori's line in particular
